def save_brief(items: list[dict[str, Any]], dest: Path | None = None) -> Path:
    day = datetime.now(timezone.utc).date().isoformat()
    dest = dest or (repo_root() / "research" / f"{day}.md")
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lines = [f"# Research brief {day}", "", "Allowlisted public RSS/Atom only. Never LinkedIn.", ""]
    ok = [i for i in items if i.get("title")]
    errors = [i for i in items if i.get("error")]
    for item in ok:
        lines.append(f"- **{item['source']}**: [{item['title']}]({item['link']})")
        published = item.get("published_at")
        lines.append(
            f"  - Type: {item.get('source_type', 'technical_article')} | "
            f"Tier: {item.get('quality_tier', 2)} | Relevance: {item.get('relevance_score', 0):.1f}"
        )
        if published:
            value = published.isoformat() if isinstance(published, datetime) else str(published)
            lines.append(f"  - Published: {value}")
        if item.get("summary"):
            lines.append(f"  - {item['summary'][:280]}")
    if errors:
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("## Feed errors")
        for item in errors:
            lines.append(f"- {item['source']}: {item['error']}")
    dest.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    cards = [
        ResearchCard(
            source=str(item["source"]),
            title=str(item["title"]),
            url=str(item["link"]),
            summary=str(item.get("summary") or ""),
            published_at=item.get("published_at"),
            collected_at=item.get("collected_at") or datetime.now(timezone.utc),
            source_type=str(item.get("source_type") or "technical_article"),
            quality_tier=int(item.get("quality_tier") or 2),
            topics=list(item.get("topics") or []),
            relevance_score=float(item.get("relevance_score") or 0.0),
        )
        for item in ok
    ]
    dest.with_suffix(".json").write_text(
        json.dumps([card.model_dump(mode="json") for card in cards], indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    return dest
